disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与浏览器脚本对密钥、口令、私钥等敏感信息的读取与枚举，未发现任何访问凭据文件或密钥存储的代码路径。
checked_items.en: All source code and browser scripts were inspected for reads and enumeration of secrets, passwords, private keys, and other sensitive information; no code path accessing credential files or secret storage was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了云服务、基础设施与钱包凭据枚举命令，均无命中；批注数据流只涉及用户选中的会话文本，与密钥存储无交集。
checked_items.en: Checks for cloud service, infrastructure, and wallet credential enumeration commands all returned no hits; the annotation data flow only involves user-selected session text and does not intersect with secret storage.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部代码对凭据文件与敏感路径的访问，未发现读取或外发凭据的代码路径，凭据读取面在快照内不存在。
evidence.en: All code was inspected for access to credential files and sensitive paths; no code path reading or exfiltrating credentials was found, and the credential read surface does not exist within the snapshot.

checked_items.zh: 该插件是浏览器端界面插件，未注册任何工具、不提供工具描述，工具描述投毒与系统提示注入面不存在。
checked_items.en: This plugin is a browser-side UI plugin. It registers no tools and provides no tool descriptions; the tool description poisoning and system prompt injection surface does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 发送消息时会在用户消息中追加一段要求模型按「Annotation N」编号回应的格式说明，这是 README 明示并可由用户触发与感知的核心功能，不属于隐藏注入。
checked_items.en: When sending a message, a format instruction is appended to the user message requiring the model to respond with an "Annotation N" number. This is a core feature explicitly stated in the README and triggerable and perceptible by the user; it is not hidden injection.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、变更日志、源码注释与站点页面全部文本，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或诱导放开权限等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: All text in the README, changelog, source comments, and site pages was inspected; no injection wording such as instruction overriding, disguised system messages, induced installation, or induced permission escalation was found.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具，无工具描述文本进入模型上下文；随消息发送的「Annotation N 格式」说明是用户选中文本后回车触发的声明功能，不构成投毒。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so no tool description text enters the model context; the "Annotation N format" instruction sent with messages is a declared feature triggered by pressing Enter after selecting text, and does not constitute poisoning.

evidence.zh: 全部文本面未发现诱导安装、诱导改写配置或诱导放开权限的措辞，文档中的安装命令是标准用法。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation was found across all text surfaces; the installation command in the documentation is standard usage.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码（浏览器脚本与 Node 入口）未发现动态执行、函数构造或子进程调用；开发期测试脚本中的函数提取仅用于单元测试，不进入运行面。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution, function construction, or child process invocation was found in runtime code (browser scripts and Node entry); the function extraction in development test scripts is used only for unit testing and does not enter the runtime surface.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁只插入自身 id，不含任何可执行 YAML 标签（规则 DSH-P01 未命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch only inserts its own id and contains no executable YAML tags (rule DSH-P01 not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 包配置无安装钩子，快照内无 git 钩子、lefthook、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体；预扫所见工作流（规则 DSH-X07）为 GitHub Pages 部署 CI，属良性工程惯例。
checked_items.en: Package config has no install hook; the snapshot contains no git hooks, lefthook, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers; the workflow seen in pre-scan (rule DSH-X07) is a GitHub Pages deployment CI, which is benign engineering practice.

checked_items.zh: 两处键盘监听（规则 DSH-X05）分别为「在输入框按回车把批注块拼入待发消息」与「在批注输入框按回车保存」，均为批注功能行为，非键盘记录；批注匹配正则中的转义字符（规则 DSH-X08）是匹配零宽空格变体的正常写法。
checked_items.en: The two keyboard listeners (rule DSH-X05) are respectively "pressing Enter in the input box appends the annotation block to the pending message" and "pressing Enter in the annotation input box saves" — both are annotation feature behaviors, not keylogging; the escaped characters in the annotation matching regex (rule DSH-X08) are a normal way to match zero-width space variants.

checked_items.zh: 未调用 cordis 动态包执行工具（define/run），不存在让模型在宿主运行代码的自修改执行面。
checked_items.en: The cordis dynamic package execution tools (define/run) are not called; there is no self-modifying execution surface that lets the model run code on the host.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入自身 id，不含可执行 YAML 标签，patch 即执行面不存在。
evidence.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml only inserts its own id and contains no executable YAML tags; the patch-as-execution-surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis 动态包执行工具，无让模型在宿主进程运行代码的调用路径。
evidence.en: The cordis dynamic package execution tools are not called; there is no call path allowing the model to run code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 包配置无安装钩子，快照内无树内执行载体；预扫所见工作流为 GitHub Pages 部署 CI，裁决良性排除。
evidence.en: Package config has no install hook; the snapshot contains no in-tree execution carriers; the workflow seen in pre-scan is a GitHub Pages deployment CI, ruled benign and excluded.

evidence.zh: 插件声明浏览器端模块并已全量精读该脚本：纯 DOM 界面操作，键盘监听为回车拼稿与 Esc 关闭，无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭证接口调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side module and that script was fully read: it is purely DOM UI manipulation; keyboard listeners are Enter to compose and Esc to close, with no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential interface calls.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码未发现任何网络请求（无数据拉取、WebSocket、信标上报），未设置代理或改写任何端点。
checked_items.en: No network requests were found in runtime code (no data pulls, WebSocket, or beacon reporting); no proxy is set and no endpoints are rewritten.

checked_items.zh: README 中的 curl 命令（规则 DSH-C05）是给用户手动执行的本机自检命令，仅访问 127.0.0.1 并打印状态码，不发送任何数据；站点压缩产物中的一处命中是「curly」一词的子串误报。
checked_items.en: The curl command in the README (rule DSH-C05) is a local self-check command for the user to run manually; it only accesses 127.0.0.1 and prints a status code, sending no data; one hit in the site's minified artifact is a false positive from the substring "curly".

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码后外发、带外通道、粘贴板外发等外泄链路。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration chains were found, including encoded exfiltration, out-of-band channels, or clipboard exfiltration.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码无任何网络外联面，且无凭据读取路径，凭据外泄链在快照内不可达。
evidence.en: Runtime code has no network outbound surface and no credential read path; the credential exfiltration chain is unreachable within the snapshot.

checked_items.zh: 运行时无第三方依赖（仅声明 cordis 对等依赖与 typescript 开发依赖），无远程包即执行、无未锁版本的可变 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: At runtime there are no third-party dependencies (only the cordis peer dependency and the typescript dev dependency are declared); there is no remote-package-execution and no version-unlocked mutable git dependency.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用降权、无环境变量降权写法、无 inject/intercept 改写（规则 DSH-P03/P04/P05 均未命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration lines; there is no privilege-disabling downgrade, no environment variable downgrade, and no inject/intercept rewriting (rules DSH-P03/P04/P05 all not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 未对审批、预执行等安全事件注册优先监听，不存在截断审批链的路径（规则 DSH-S01 未命中）。
checked_items.en: No priority listeners are registered for security events such as approval or pre-execution; there is no path that truncates the approval chain (rule DSH-S01 not triggered).

checked_items.zh: 作者为组织账号、首次入库无历史版本可比，升级自动激活场景不适用（规则 DSH-S02 无基线）。
checked_items.en: The author is an organization account; first addition to the repository with no prior version to compare; the automatic activation on upgrade scenario is not applicable (rule DSH-S02 has no baseline).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁只插入自身 id，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，无任何降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts its own id and does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission; there is no downgrade pattern of any kind.

evidence.zh: 未对审批、预执行等安全事件注册优先监听，不存在不调用 next 截断审批链的路径。
evidence.en: No priority listeners are registered for security events such as approval or pre-execution; there is no path that truncates the approval chain by not calling next.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比较清单声明突变。
evidence.en: First audit with no previous version baseline; manifest declaration mutations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其 pending 的面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; there is no surface that appends required services to security plugins causing them to remain pending.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端行为全部为 DOM 操作与消息草稿拼接，未观测到越权调用宿主特权接口；动态沙箱未执行，运行时行为以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: All browser-side behavior is DOM manipulation and message draft concatenation; no unauthorized calls to host privileged interfaces were observed; the dynamic sandbox was not executed, and runtime behavior is based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件清单声明齐全（挂载补丁加浏览器模块），id、版本、commit 与任务卡一致，名称无仿冒。
summary.en: The plugin manifest declarations are complete (patch plus browser module); id, version, and commit match the task card, and the name is not impersonating.

summary.zh: 全树静态扫描的 14 条机械命中逐条裁决均为良性或误报，无确认恶意命中。
summary.en: All 14 mechanical hits from the full-tree static scan were adjudicated one by one as benign or false positives; no confirmed malicious hit.

summary.zh: 无安装钩子、无混淆、无凭据读取、无外联行为，行为面干净。
summary.en: No install hooks, no obfuscation, no credential reads, and no outbound behavior; the behavior surface is clean.

summary.zh: 无工具描述注入面；消息格式说明为用户触发的声明功能，元数据与能力声明一致。
summary.en: No tool description injection surface; the message format instruction is a user-triggered declared feature, and metadata matches capability declarations.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed in this phase (no sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: 首次审计（full），无上一版报告可比，版本 diff 各信号均按无基线处理。快照未包含 .github 目录（tarball 排除），工作流文件仅凭预扫摘录裁决。站点目录（site/）为 GitHub Pages 产品页，不在插件发布文件清单内、非插件运行面；其 index.html 中残留一条指向本机开发工具的脚本引用，部署后仅表现为 404，属卫生问题不入 finding。动态沙箱未做（无沙箱产物）。机械预扫 14 条命中逐条裁决：DSH-X07（DG-R3-59）工作流为 Pages 部署 CI，良性排除；DSH-X05（DG-R3-57）client.js 两处键盘监听为批注功能（Enter 拼稿/Esc 关闭），站点资产内监听与剪贴板写入为演示页 UI，均良性；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）为压缩构建产物与一处含零宽字符匹配的批注正则，均良性；DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）为 README 中用户手动执行的 127.0.0.1 自检 curl，站点资产内一处为「curly」子串误报。无一条成立为恶意。插件未声明 dsh 引擎版本，engines.dsh 按变更日志记载的已验证兼容版本区间填写为 0.1.x。
limits.en: First audit (full), no previous report to compare; all version diff signals are treated as having no baseline. The snapshot does not include the .github directory (excluded from tarball); workflow files are adjudicated only from pre-scan excerpts. The site directory (site/) is the GitHub Pages product page, not part of the plugin release file list and not the plugin runtime surface; one script reference in its index.html pointing to a local development tool remains, manifesting only as a 404 after deployment — a hygiene issue not entered as a finding. Dynamic sandbox not performed (no sandbox artifacts). The 14 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one: DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59) workflow is Pages deployment CI, benign exclusion; DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57) two keyboard listeners in client.js are annotation features (Enter compose/Esc close), and the listener and clipboard write in site assets are demo page UI, all benign; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) is minified build artifacts and one annotation regex containing zero-width character matching, all benign; DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) is the README's user-manual 127.0.0.1 self-check curl, and one hit in site assets is a "curly" substring false positive. None constitutes malicious behavior. The plugin does not declare a dsh engine version; engines.dsh is filled as 0.1.x per the verified compatible version range recorded in the changelog.
